exact_result: Locally bounded real generated CLD Psh sections have positive doubly closed ordinary multipliers for every original field, ordinary open and allowed middle-positive doubly closed current; full sheafified ordinal proof and Borel product audit. Also, linear subspaces of classical pluriharmonic functions on a fixed compact affinoid are closed under pointwise convergent nets, with uniform convergence. No universal pair equality or analytic counterexample.
concrete_gaps: No construction makes both signs of an arbitrary continuous generated-Psh equal-curvature pair difference generated Psh on a fixed ordinary neighbourhood.
No preservation theorem for general exact signed curvature dependencies against an arbitrary allowed singular ordinary current.
No analytic curve restriction or transcendental scalar-current ascent of the ambient ordinary Hessian equality is proved.
No all-refinement-compatible positive doubly closed regularization/density theorem for arbitrary currents is proved.
No actual analytic admissible pair, current and compact smooth test with a nonzero product difference is constructed.
